slides.texte_overlay:
green flags you're becoming
smarter without noticing

you ask follow up questions

you no longer accept the first answer you hear. asking one more question to really understand is one of the clearest signs of a quietly sharpening mind.

you enjoy documentaries

you'd rather watch a good documentary than another random show. choosing to learn in your free time says a lot about where your mind is quietly heading.

you crave learning

you look forward to 5 minutes of learning more than to 5 minutes of scrolling: a painting, a planet, a moment in history. that shift says everything about you.
slides.texte_sophia:
you crave learning

i look forward to my 5 minute lesson more than scrolling now: a painting, a planet. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and that shift says everything about me.

slides.texte_overlay:
you notice your biases

you catch yourself jumping to conclusions and stop to check. noticing your own blind spots is a level of honest thinking that most people never reach.

you explain things simply

you can explain complicated ideas in simple words to friends. making the complex sound easy is one of the truest and rarest signs of real understanding.
